changelog: Added competitive Multi-Bank ecosystem (Fleeca, Maze Bank, Pacific Standard, Bank of Liberty).
Added prestigious card tiers (Classic, Silver, Gold, Black/Metal) with custom perks and sounds.
Added joint accounts and shared vaults with co-holder live spending notifications.
Added automated recurring standing orders and company payroll scheduler.
Added Revolut-style spare change Vault Roundups into micro-savings.
Added wireless handheld POS terminal (TPE) with 3D animation and contactless NFC payments.
Added overdraft protection lines, cardless ATM OTP withdrawals, disposable virtual cards, and term deposits.
